title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Page 659, section 8, 'Les groupes N_σ, N_σ^♮'. This is part of Grothendieck's sequel to the Longue Marche: a detailed study of an automorphism group (scheme) G_{ρ,σ} over a base S_0. That group is attached to the genus-1 / modular situation with two distinguished elements, ρ of order 6 (or 3) and σ of order 4, as for the standard generators of SL_2(Z). Its neutral component G° = M is a vector group G_a^2 with basis λ_0, λ_1. There is a character χ to a group O_12^* (or D_12^*, a finite or multiplicative-type group scheme), and a sign map ε_2 to μ = (±1)_{S_0}. The previous page treated the normalizer-type group N_ρ attached to ρ. This page does the same for σ.

(173) N_σ is the subgroup of sections u of G_{ρ,σ} with u(σ) = σ^{ε_2(u)}, i.e. u normalizes σ, sending it to σ or σ^{-1}. Grothendieck also writes this as ω^{ν_2(u)}σ.

(174) N_σ^♮ = N_σ ∩ G^♮_{ρ,σ}.

The composite χ_σ: N_σ^♮ → G^*_{ρ,σ} → O_12^* is an epimorphism. Indeed certain explicit lifts u_μ lie in N_σ^♮, which gives a splitting O_12^* ↪ N_σ^♮.

(175) This gives semidirect product decompositions N_σ^♮ ≅ O_12^* ⋉ SZ_σ^♮ and N_σ ≅ O_12^* ⋉ SZ_σ.

(176) The groups involved are:
- Z_σ = Ker(ε_2∘χ_σ), the centralizer of σ in G_{ρ,σ};
- SZ_σ = Z_σ ∩ G^+, the centralizer of σ in G^+;
- Z_σ^♮ and SZ_σ^♮, the intersections with the ♮-part. SZ_σ^♮ is the intersection with G° = M, so it is the centralizer of σ in M.

Next, SZ_σ maps to Cent_{H^+_{S_0}}(σ). This target contains L_σ ≅ (Z/4Z)_{S_0}, the subgroup generated by σ, via δ_12. The map has a section.

(177) Hence SZ_σ ≅ L_σ × SZ_σ^♮.

The next page computes SZ_σ^♮ = M^σ. Since σ swaps λ_0 and λ_1, this is {a(λ_0+λ_1)} ≅ G_a. So N_σ^♮ ≅ O_12^* ⋉ G_a and N_σ ≅ O_12^* ⋉ (L_σ × G_a). Here O_12^* acts on G_a through χ and on L_σ through ε_2.

Purpose: list the remarkable subgroups (normalizers and centralizers of the torsion elements ρ and σ) of this group scheme. This is analogous to the diagram (38) on p. 622, and is part of describing the stabilizers of the 'elliptic points' of the genus-1 Teichmüller/modular object.
errors: In (176) the last line '= G° = M' is sloppy. SZ_σ^♮ is the intersection with G° = M, i.e. the centralizer of σ in M, which is G_a (corrected on the next page, (178)). It is not M itself.

The claim in (175) that N_σ ≅ O_12^*·SZ_σ needs Ker(χ_σ on N_σ) = SZ_σ. This is plausible given the definitions but is not verified on the page. The justification of the splitting ('les u_μ sont dans N_σ^♮') is only sketched with ellipses.

ideas.what: Normalizer N_σ of the order-4 element σ in an automorphism group scheme, split as a semidirect product of a finite/multiplicative group O_12^* with the centralizer
ideas.modern_name: Normalizer/centralizer decomposition of stabilizers of elliptic (order 4) points; semidirect products of group schemes
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard group theory; context Grothendieck's Teichmüller tower program
ideas.where_published: Context related to Esquisse d'un programme / La Longue Marche (genus-1 modular groupoid), but these explicit computations are unpublished

ideas.what: Centralizer of σ in the neutral component M ≅ G_a^2 is the fixed line G_a·(λ_0+λ_1), giving SZ_σ ≅ Z/4 × G_a
ideas.modern_name: Fixed points of an involutive linear action on a vector group

deep.surprise_reason: Routine bookkeeping of normalizers and centralizers inside a specific group scheme from Grothendieck's unpublished genus-1 Teichmüller study. It is interesting as archival detail, but there is no new result or connection beyond what the program already implies.
transcription_corrections: The superscript written 'S' in N_σ^S, G^S, Z_σ^S is most likely the natural sign '♮', consistent with the next page (N_σ^♮, SZ_σ^♮).
'𝔻_12^*' should probably read '𝕆_12^*' (O_12^*), as on the next page.
'les u_♯ sont dans 𝔾_2[?] N_σ^S' is likely 'les u_μ sont dans N_σ^♮', referring to the lifts indexed by μ ∈ O_12^*.
In the composite homomorphism, the first arrow label χ_σ is crossed out and replaced by the underbrace naming the composite χ_σ.
